The successful candidate will be responsible for analyzing, designing, and guiding network architecture to ensure cybersecurity is integrated from the ground up, aligning with federal standards such as NIST 800-53, FISMA, and FAA Orders. Support the integration of Zero Trust, SDN, and defense-in-depth strategies into enterprise solutions. Evaluate vendor-proposed architectures and provide expert recommendations aligned with federal policies and industry best practices. A supportive and inclusive work environment that values diversity and innovation. Recognition programs that honor exceptional performance and contributions. review_candidates.title: Linux Systems Engineer - Server Migration
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Linux Systems Engineer – Server Migration Team/Function Description: Goldman Sachs is a leading global investment banking, securities, and investment management firm. Our Unix Engineering team is a global group responsible for architecting and managing the Linux, Virtualization, and Server Hardware computing platform that powers critical operations at Goldman Sachs. We partner closely with application developers and strategists to build and deploy innovative technology solutions. Currently, we are undertaking a critical data center migration initiative , relocating servers and workloads from one facility to another, and are developing next-generation compute platform solutions to support this effort. Job Summary: The Linux Systems Engineer – Server Migration role is a vital position within the Unix Engineering team, responsible for supporting the firm's large-scale server migration project , which involves relocating physical and virtual infrastructure between data center locations. This includes planning and executing migrations of ESXi hosts and virtual machines , managing iSCSI storage network configurations , working with LVM (Logical Volume Manager) for storage provisioning and migration, and ensuring seamless cutover with minimal downtime. The role also encompasses system configuration management, performance testing and tuning, and application and service troubleshooting throughout the migration lifecycle. The ideal candidate will be passionate about exploring and integrating technologies, such as VMWare, ISCSI network, Linux, SaltStack, and OpenShift, to drive the continued evolution of our highly scalable compute platform. Responsibilities: Own and engineer the Linux compute platform at Goldman Sachs during the server migration project , ensuring its stability, security, and performance throughout all migration phases. Plan, coordinate, and execute end-to-end server migrations from the source data center to the target location, including physical servers, ESXi hosts, and virtual machines. Manage and migrate VMware ESXi environments , including vMotion, Storage vMotion, and cold migrations of VMs across data center sites with minimal service disruption. Configure, troubleshoot, and migrate iSCSI storage networks , ensuring proper connectivity, multipathing, CHAP authentication, and performance between source and target environments. Manage LVM (Logical Volume Manager) configurations during migration, including volume group export/import, logical volume resizing, snapshot-based migrations, and filesystem integrity validation. Develop and maintain automation tooling to streamline migration tasks , implement, scale, and test infrastructure services for repeatable and reliable migration workflows. Develop and execute migration runbooks, rollback plans, and validation checklists to ensure each migration wave is completed successfully and within defined maintenance windows. Collaborate with internal clients and partner engineering teams across the organization to understand their needs, assess migration readiness , and deliver effective solutions. Contribute to the evolution and integration of modern stack components, including Kubernetes, OpenStack, and other emerging technologies, as part of the post-migration target architecture . Work closely with 1st- and 2nd-level support organizations to perform in-depth technical troubleshooting and resolve complex issues arising during and after migration activities . Develop and implement technical solutions and process improvements to enhance system reliability, efficiency, and scalability in the target data center environment . Manage and optimize virtualization environments using VMware (ESXi) and Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization (CNV), with a focus on cross-site VM migration and re-platforming . Participate in the design and implementation of CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure as code to support automated migration and provisioning workflows . Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement proactive measures to ensure optimal performance before, during, and after each migration wave . Ensure adherence to security best practices and compliance requirements across the Linux infrastructure throughout the migration lifecycle . Skills, Qualifications, and Experience: Mandatory: Bachelor's Degree in a Science or Engineering program with a minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in a relevant role. Proven experience leading or participating in large-scale data center or server migration projects , including physical-to-virtual (P2V), virtual-to-virtual (V2V), and site-to-site migrations. Extensive experience with the architecture, implementation, and operation of Linux-based compute environments, including a deep understanding of Linux OS internals. Strong hands-on expertise with VMware ESXi/vSphere , including ESXi host builds, VM provisioning, vMotion, Storage vMotion, DRS, HA, and cross-site ESXi and VM migration techniques . In-depth knowledge of iSCSI storage networking , including iSCSI initiator/target configuration, multipathing (DM-Multipath), network segmentation for storage traffic, jumbo frames, and troubleshooting iSCSI connectivity issues. Expert-level understanding of LVM (Logical Volume Manager) , including physical volume, volume group, and logical volume management; LVM snapshots; volume group migration (vgexport/vgimport); thin provisioning; and LVM-based backup and restore strategies. In-depth knowledge of advanced networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, load balancing, VLAN configuration for iSCSI networks ) and traditional storage platforms. Proven experience with containerization technologies and tools, such as OpenShift, Kubernetes, and Docker, including orchestration and management at scale. Strong understanding of software development and CI/CD tools, including Git, Subversion, Maven, and Jenkins. Expertise in virtualization products from VMware (ESXi) and Red Hat (OpenShift CNV) for managing compute infrastructure at scale. Demonstrated ability to set and achieve project goals when implementing and integrating complex technology concepts, particularly within structured migration timelines and maintenance windows . Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash and Python for automation of migration tasks and system administration. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex system issues and identify effective solutions, especially in high-pressure migration scenarios . Optional: Expertise in one or more scripting and/or high-level languages such as Python, Node.js, Perl, or Go, with experience using REST API interfaces. Experience with migration tools and frameworks such as VMware vCenter Converter, Zerto, Veeam, or custom migration orchestration scripts. Experience using and developing against relational (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra). Significant exposure to major public cloud providers (AWS, Google Cloud Platform, and Azure), including hybrid or cloud-assisted migration strategies . Familiarity with security practices and platforms, including encryption, certificates, key management, OAuth, and LDAP. Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef, particularly for post-migration configuration validation and drift detection . Knowledge of monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK stack, with experience setting up migration-specific dashboards and alerting .
